column1: #mapping_set_description: Legacy refgenie 0.x genome configuration file (genome_config.yaml, config_version 0.4), read by refgenconf and by Galaxy's 'refgenie' tool data table type. Also accepts the bare 'genomes' block that refgenieserver 0.x serves at /_private_api/genomes/dict. The adapter gives one record per genome/asset/tag; map keys (genome digest, asset name, tag name) appear as {genome}, {asset}, {tag} placeholders in the paths.
